item.content:encoded:
A question about Alpha-9 at this point in the series…

"I don't mean to complain, but… between all of us, we requested access to over two hundred SCP items. Our list now is… Do we even have half a dozen? Besides Iris, we have Cain, a broken reality bender, a severed hand…"

This seemed like another manipulation, even if Light herself was genuine. They'd manipulated Able, too, given him control over the makeup of the Omega-7 strike team, let him strut around Site-17, indulged his homicidal desires, so long as he was useful…

This tale makes more clear, something that I've been wondering about … they've only got a handful of candidates lined up and are still actively looking for more. My question is: What criteria are being used (in-universe / out of universe) for inclusion? My headcanon has them evaluating, for sapient SCPs:

  • Meeting criteria for Field Agent training - Psych profile, Physical Stamina, Intelligence etc.
  • Anomalous trait(s) can be classed as 'Ability' - stable, operate under well-understood limits, under active, conscious control
  • The object possesses 'Abilities' of sufficient operational benefit to warrant field use
  • Loyalty to / affiliation with the Foundation and its mission
  • Does not present an excessive threat (to team members, the Foundation, normalcy, Humanity or Reality) in the event of loss or breach of control

But maybe right now they can't be so selective and they're taking what scraps they can get? I figured that Iris would push back sooner or later, and based on her experience with Omega-7, she'd insist on more input into the vetting process - is that something that may come up in later installments?
